video.title: AI欧腐《镜头之外/Off Camera》
video.desc:
Payne Grayson and Noah Ashford are two of the biggest stars in the industry and the public sees them as bitter rivals. But behind years of conflict, ambition, and desire lies a secret relationship that began during a blackout audition seven years earlier. As scandal, family pressure, and public scrutiny close in, they must choose between protecting their careers and telling the truth about each other.
Payne Grayson和Noah Ashford是娱乐圈最炙手可热的两位巨星。在公众眼中，他们是水火不容的死对头。
可在多年冲突、野心与欲望的背后，隐藏着一段不为人知的秘密关系——那段关系，始于七年前一场停电中的试镜。
如今，丑闻、家庭压力和公众审视步步逼近。两人必须在保护事业与坦白彼此之间做出选择：是继续把真相藏在镜头之外，还是勇敢公开这段早已无法掩饰的感情。
